messages:
sam: Hey @support, our tool call to 'ingest_blob' started failing after updating python SDK to 0.9.2. Getting schema validation error: "args.data: expected string matching base64, got object". Repro below.

sam: repro (Python):
```python
from redwood import Client
c = Client(api_key=...)
blob = b"\x00\x01\x02"
c.call_tool('ingest_blob', args={'data': blob})
```

sam: Server error from our logs:
```
400 Bad Request: schema validation failed: args.data must be string (format: base64) got object {"type":"Buffer","data":[0,1,2]}
```

maria: thanks — sending to SDK team. Can you paste the raw HTTP request body if possible?

sam: here's what arrives at your endpoint (redacted):
```
{"tool":"ingest_blob","args":{"data":{"type":"Buffer","data":[0,1,2]}}}
```

aj: I can reproduce locally. Python SDK (0.9.2) is turning bytes into Node-style Buffer dict when serializing nested kwargs. TS/Go clients send base64 strings. That mismatch triggers schema validation.

aj: quick workaround for you: manually base64 encode before calling:
```python
import base64
c.call_tool('ingest_blob', args={'data': base64.b64encode(blob).decode()})
```

kevin: thanks @aj. Root cause from SDK review: serializer used json.dumps on objects coming from third-party 'msgpack' layer which returns Node Buffer-like dicts for bytes. Python SDK should detect bytes and convert to base64 string instead of leaving dict wrapper.

kevin: patch queued: https://git.internal/redwood/sdk-python/pull/789 (fix: bytes -> base64 string for toolcall args, add unit + e2e). Rolling a hotfix to 0.9.3.

maria: ETA on release?

aj: aiming to cut 0.9.3 today. hotfix branch already has tests. expect wheels in ~3-4 hours. Will post changelog.

sam: thanks — can you also confirm: will this affect existing stored usages? our bot built on top of TS client still fine.

aj: no breaking changes. We only change serializer when encountering Python bytes/bytearray. TS/Go unchanged.

ci-bot: deploy pipeline succeeded for hotfix branch -> canary starts

maria: assigning to CS ticket CS-4821, will loop back to customer once patched.

sam: thanks — temporary workaround worked, can confirm base64 manual encoding accepted.

maria: closing loop once 0.9.3 published; thx for patience :heart:
